basics.name: Tee Wei Jie
basics.label: IT Development Officer | Internal Tools & Data Automation
basics.summary: IT professional in a manufacturing environment with over 8 years of experience supporting office operations, infrastructure, and internal workflow improvement. Uses programming as a practical tool to automate repetitive tasks, analyze data, import business data, and build small internal applications that help office staff work more efficiently. Experienced with Windows Server, Active Directory, C#/.NET, Python, SQL, IIS, and Next.js.

work.name: Bibi&Baba Private Limited
work.summary: Supports the IT needs of a manufacturing office environment while building practical internal tools that simplify daily administrative and operational work.
highlights: **Key Achievement:** Built internal tools to automate repetitive data import and checking tasks, reducing manual work for office staff.
Created data analysis utilities that helped office users review business information more quickly and consistently.
Standardized recurring spreadsheet-based workflows by converting them into reusable scripts and small applications.
Supported office staff by turning manual data preparation tasks into guided tools with validation and clearer output.
Maintained internal applications used for daily data lookup, reporting, and administrative workflows.

work.name: Bibi&Baba Private Limited

Gained hands-on experience with server-side troubleshooting, DNS, and DHCP configurations.
Acted as the bridge between hardware infrastructure and software requirements.
Continued to refine automation scripts, paving the way for more complex software development tasks.

work.name: Bibi&Baba Private Limited
